sentences.text:
BETWEEN:-
 JEEVAN SINGH, S/O SHRI ANUP SINGH, AGED ABOUT 31  YEARS, OCCUPATION: LABOUR R/O MALWA COLONY,
 REHTI, P.S. AND TEHSIL REHTI, DISTRICT SEHORE  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SATYAM AGRAWAL - ADVOCATE)
 AND  1. THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH  THE POLICE STATION REHTI DISTRICT SEHORE  (MADHYA PRADESH)
2 . PROSECUTRIX VICTIM X D/O NOT MENTION NOT  MENTION (MADHYA PRADESH)

This appeal coming on for admission this day, th e cour  following:
 ORDER

This first criminal appeal is filed by the appellant under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.114/2023, dated 28.03.2023, registered at Police Station Rehti, District Sehore for commission of offence under Sections 376(2)(n), 376D, 506 of IPC and Section 3(2)(v), 3(1)(w)(i) of SC/ST (POA) Act and 5(1)(d) of the Immoral Traffic (Prevention) Act, 1956.

As prayed by learned counsel for the appellant, this Criminal Appeal under Section 14-A of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act for grant of bail under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. to the appellant - Jeevan Jeevan Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111509086/
1

sentences.text: Singh is dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed.
However, as prayed, appellant shall be at liberty to renew the prayer for grant of bail after prosecutrix's evidence before the trial Court.
